out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Food or Color Additive
violations.observation: The following unsafe or unapproved food or color additives is applied to food: 1) black lava salt containing activated charcoal Upon discussion with PIC, black lava salt is used on the rim of a cocktail.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from the addition of unsafe or unapproved food or color additives AND unsafe or unapproved levels of approved foods and color additives. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ACTIVATED CHARCOAL IS AN UNAPPROVED FOOD ADDITIVE. PIC STATE HE WILL DISCONTINUE USING THE SALT ON THE COCKTAIL AND WILL INFORM CORPORATE.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) the interior liner ice machine door of the crushed ice machine was observed not attached to the door itself. Observed excessive glue on the exterior of the ice machine
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE REPAIR DOOR AND CLEAN GLUE OF THIS ICE MACHINE BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. HYATT REGENCY MAIN KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 06/23/2026) Page 2 of 3
